frequency_question: How often does the Fed complete a regulatory capital buffer adjustment within a 109-day calendar window given full cooperation?
membership_rule: Includes any formal Board of Governors process to adjust macroprudential capital buffers (like CCyB). Excludes standard monetary rate-setting FOMC decisions.
coverage_note: 3 named historical instances of substantive CCyB calibration events or framework setups since inception.
known_gaps: Limited sample size due to the CCyB tool being rarely actively modified above 0% in U.S. banking history.
skeleton: Regulatory review cycles (3 historical major touchpoints) multiplied by execution probability within a single calendar quarter.
validity_reason: Regulatory frameworks and procedural timelines for rule changes remain stable over multi-year horizons.
